messages:
Alice (PM): Quick sync — finalizing SLA tiers + docs/playbook for upcoming launch. Need owners for SLO calc, runbooks, pricing blurb, support routing.

Ben (Eng): Proposed tiers:
- Standard: p95 < 150ms, p99 < 500ms, availability 99.9%
- Business: p95 < 100ms, p99 < 300ms, availability 99.95%
- Enterprise: dedicated capacity, custom SLOs, availability 99.99% + 24/7 support

Carla (Support): Support routing suggestion:
- Standard -> ticket queue (biz hours)
- Business -> priority email + 4hr response SLA
- Enterprise -> pager + named SE + 1hr response

Dan (Oncall): Runbooks we need:
- model-fallback -> steps to switch to fallback variant and warm caches
- traffic-shift -> script to route X% to backup region
- post-mortem checklist

Emily (Docs): I can draft the playbook and quickstarts. Need example alert text and sample curl snippets. I'll include a monitoring dashboard layout.

Frank (Sales): Pricing questions: do we want seat-based addons or commit tiers? propose Business = +30% over Standard unit price; Enterprise = bespoke. Also want a short "What's included" blurb for the pricing page.

Grace (Legal): Need SLA wording template + exclusions. Also must define how service credits are calculated (hours out / monthly invoice vs %). Will review once we have exact targets.

Ben (Eng): Monitoring plan: surface per-tenant p95/p99, error_rate_1m, kv_cache_hit_rate, queue_length. Alerts:
```
alert if p99 > 600ms for 5m -> paging
alert if availability < 99.9% for 30m -> ticket
```

infra-bot: deploybot has completed canary deploy to us-west-2 :white_check_mark:

Alice (PM): Owners + deliverables:
- SLO spreadsheet: Ben
- Runbooks: Dan + Ben
- Operational playbook/docs: Emily
- Support routing doc: Carla
- Pricing blurb & bundles: Frank
- SLA legal text: Grace
Target: lock scope + ship checklist in 5 business days. Can everyone ack? :eyes:

Carla (Support): Ack. I'll create the routing doc and put a small escalation matrix.

Ben (Eng): Ack, I'll populate the SLO spreadsheet and push metrics to the dashboard.

Dan (Oncall): Ack, will draft runbooks and traffic-shift script.

Emily (Docs): Ack — will open a PR with a playbook skeleton and examples.

Frank (Sales): Ack. I'll draft the customer-facing bullets and pricing deltas.

Grace (Legal): Ack. Will prepare SLA clauses and exceptions for review.

Alice (PM): Cool. I'll schedule a 30m sync Monday 10am PT to review draft artifacts and lock language. If anyone needs to move earlier ping me. :thumbsup:

Ben (Eng): small follow-up — we should include "graceful degradation" examples in docs (e.g., shortened completions, fallback models). I'll add sample configs.

Emily (Docs): noted — will include a "how the system degrades" section with examples and sample API responses.

Alice (PM): Thanks team. We'll aim to close by EOD Friday. I'll post a single checklist link once PRs are opened. :wave:
